long_biography.plain_text:
Cobega traces its origins to Santiago Daurella's Barcelona Coca-Cola bottling business, established in 1951. Alfonso Líbano Daurella belongs to the third generation that broadened the platform beyond its original Spanish franchise. Its later ventures included Nespresso distribution through Daba, African bottling through Equatorial and the Cacaolat dairy-drinks business.

Family-enterprise succession has become a major part of Líbano's institutional work. He chairs the Family Business Network, where work with multigenerational companies has emphasised continuity, responsible ownership and preparation of successors. In Barcelona, he also serves as a vice chair of the MACBA foundation, which supports the city's contemporary-art museum.
